descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · S08 「浏览器里，过期的会话（闲置 12 h，然后 30 d）在下一次服务器调用时回到登录界面，用新验证码能进回来、不被锁；不到 30 d 的还开着」 In the browser, an expired session (12 h idle, then 30 d) lands on the sign-in screen at the next server call, and a new code gets back in without a lock-out; just under 30 d stays open

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U3 After 12 hours idle, the physician has to sign in again with an email OTP.（UAT OAT-01 step 3；UAT OAT-01 Expected；TFA-94513 AC 4） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress
  • U4 At 30 days the session hard-expires, however active it is. On day 31, access needs a new email OTP.（UAT OAT-01 step 4；UAT OAT-01 Expected；TFA-94513 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given The lane C fixture (signed in and consented, one Hospital patient and one Nursing Home resident), run once per variant: idle-12h, max-age-30d, max-age-29d (inside edge) and idle-12h-nh (Nursing Home)

When The agent opens the chart. The runner ages the session on the server. The agent reloads the page (or opens the other list from the menu), which forces new server calls, and waits up to 20 s for Send sign-in code. Then it signs in again with a fresh code from the runner.

Then After ageing, the next server call lands on the sign-in screen and the chart is gone. Signing in again with a new email code goes straight back to the list: no trial-ended message and no agreements screen (already accepted). In max-age-29d the chart is still there after the reload. idle-12h-nh behaves the same from the Nursing Home chart.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs checkpoints: cp2 must show the sign-in form and must not show the patient (max-age-29d: the reverse). cp3 must show the patient and must not show 'Before you start' (TFA-94700 AC 8: shown once) or 'Send sign-in code'. Judged against U3 / U4 (OTP required again; not before 30 d) and Q9 (day 31 is not a lock-out). …

在哪跑：本地 probes（多端探针）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S08 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-01.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane probes。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：TIME · 时间 / 老化（改时钟） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：probes。

UAT item: OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-01/S08

In the browser, an expired session (12 h idle, then 30 d) lands on the sign-in screen at the next server call, and a new code gets back in without a lock-out; just under 30 d stays open

Tickets: TFA-94513 Signing In & Session Security (in progress)

本地新 lane probes：probes/results.json 里 status passed → 通过（通过）。

怎么测（probes/plan.json，automatable: yes）：Scripted probe, 4 variants (idle-12h, max-age-30d, max-age-29d, idle-12h-nh): open chart, age the session on the server with _backdateForTests, reload, expect sign-in (29 d: still in), sign in with a runner-issued code: back on the list with the patient, no agreements, no lock-out text. — session-control + variants as separate tests.

Detail:

idle-12h, max-age-30d, idle-12h-nh: reload lands on 'Send sign-in code' (0.2–0.4 s), chart hidden; a new code returns to the chart (patient shown, no agreements screen, no lock-out text). max-age-29d: still signed in, chart shown after reload. Note: re-sign-in lands back on the chart the physician was on, not the list (oracle checks met).

证据：附了 4 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — The runner ages the session with sessions:_backdateForTests and issues the new code with seed:issueTestOtp, both through the local admin key, and the agent then signs in again with that code.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
